def feat(n, rows, label):
    a=np.array([[int(ch) for ch in r] for r in rows])
    h,w=a.shape
    rr,cc=np.indices(a.shape); inds=np.argwhere(a)
    # moment features; top vs bottom
    rc=a.sum(1); ccnt=a.sum(0)
    # vertical center of mass offset, skew (row third central moment), edge widths
    cy=(rr*a).sum()/a.sum(); cx=(cc*a).sum()/a.sum()
    hsym=all(np.array_equal(a[i],a[h-1-i]) for i in range(h//2))
    vsym=all(np.array_equal(a[:,j],a[:,w-1-j]) for j in range(w//2))
    rot=np.array_equal(a, np.rot90(a,2))
    # differences top/bottom and first/last row locations
    return dict(name=n,h=h,w=w,area=int(a.sum()),density=a.mean(),label=label,cy=cy,cx=cx,hsym=hsym,vsym=vsym,rot=rot,
                rowcounts=tuple(rc),colcounts=tuple(ccnt),top=int(rc[0]),bot=int(rc[-1]), top_x=np.flatnonzero(a[0]).mean(),bot_x=np.flatnonzero(a[-1]).mean(),
                center_r=(h-1)/2, center_c=(w-1)/2)
features=[feat(*e) for e in ex_shapes]
